subject.title: feat: Discord channel-per-agent binding display in Gateway UI (ZZ-20260311-005)

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class read-only routing bindings RPC and selected-agent bindings panel to the core Gateway/Control UI?
rationale: This adds public Gateway protocol and Control UI surface for existing routing config, and the open fork PR needs maintainer direction before a parallel fix PR or port makes sense.

options.title: Adopt read-only routing visibility
options.body: Proceed with a current-main implementation or port of the linked fork PR that exposes route/ACP bindings and filters them by selected agent in the Agents Channels panel.

options.title: Keep visibility in config/docs only
options.body: Do not add a new RPC or panel now; rely on config editing/docs and close the linked implementation path as product scope not planned.

options.title: Narrow to a different surface
options.body: Request a smaller diagnostics/config-schema view instead of a dedicated `routing.list` API if maintainers want less protocol surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt read-only routing visibility
recommendation.body: Proceed with a current-main implementation or port of the linked fork PR that exposes route/ACP bindings and filters them by selected agent in the Agents Channels panel.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is the clearest recent owner signal for the current Gateway/UI files that would need the port and product-shape review.
